evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: The utterance uses protocol-like cadence and native rollback terminology to state a categorical operational rule.
The compressed label uses domain vocabulary natively and precisely.
The label is flat and instrumental, presenting responsibility without elaboration.
